settings.reward_truncation: left; retain generated response and most recent context
settings.sequence_logp: sum over response tokens, including EOS; prompt/padding masked
settings.overflow_preference_prompt: if prompt >= context cap, retain common suffix of cap//2 tokens
settings.generation_prompt_truncation: left; retain up to max_sequence_length tokens
settings.response_length: generated tokens after prompt through first EOS inclusive; padding excluded
settings.generation_prompts: all standard held-out pairs in file order; separate common word-limit set
